header.function_name: TBD ELIPS TC-PBR to PAS PR Interface (Talend DB-to-DB)

revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: Initial draft: DB-to-DB redesign of the current tJava JSON-to-PAS job

revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: [DB-R1] Database mapping revised (ELIPS side): placeholders resolved to ielp.SA_HEADER / SA_DETAIL (status = PAS_* columns), sub items = SA_WBS_PERCENTAGE (inferred), fixed parameters = TB_M_SYSTEM (inferred); PAS tables unchanged (outside ELIPS); no sample data

revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: [DB-R2] Conflicts resolved by decision 14-Nov-26: existing application logic kept; no DB change needed

objective: To create a PAS Purchase Requisition for every approved SA of ELIPS TC-PBR, reading ELIPS directly (DB-to-DB) instead of the JSON input of the current Talend tJava job.
To reuse the existing PAS logic unchanged: PROCESS_ID, PR numbering, PR tables, SP_ILS_GENERATE_PR_ITEM, budget processing and Auto PO job.
To process each SA in its own PAS transaction, never create a second PR for the same SA, and return PR_NO or the error to ELIPS.

BEGIN TRAN: PROCESS_ID, log, PR number
Insert PR header / item / sub item

steps.text: Start the run (schedule / on demand, TBD); log message no. 1. Open two connections: ELIPS (auto-commit ON) and PAS (auto-commit OFF, SET XACT_ABORT ON, LOCK_TIMEOUT and query timeout TBD).
children: Connection error: log message no. 2. Stop.

steps.text: Recovery: for every SA in ielp.SA_DETAIL with INTERFACE_STATUS 'PROCESSING' and START_DT older than the timeout (TBD, proposed 30 min): SELECT PR_NO, PROCESS_ID FROM TB_R_PR_H WHERE PR_DESC = SA_NUMBER.
children: Found: SUCCESS with that PR_NO / PROCESS_ID. Not found: FAILED, RETRY_COUNT + 1 ('Recovered after timeout'). log message no. 4.

steps.text: Select eligible SA: INTERFACE_STATUS 'READY', or 'FAILED' with RETRY_COUNT < maximum (TBD, proposed 3); SA approved by VPLD (conceptual: approval history (TBD) APPROVAL_ROLE 'VPLD' and APPROVAL_STATUS 'APPROVED' - TBD - Requires ELIPS table/column confirmation); not PROCESSING; at least one detail; order by SA_NUMBER.
children: None: log message no. 3; go to step 12. FAILED with RETRY_COUNT = maximum is not selected (log message no. 18).

steps.text: Per SA (one iteration, steps 4-11). Claim: UPDATE ielp.SA_DETAIL SET INTERFACE_STATUS 'PROCESSING', START_DT, END_DT NULL, ERROR_MESSAGE NULL WHERE SA_NUMBER = ? AND INTERFACE_STATUS IN ('READY','FAILED'); commit in ELIPS.
children: Rows affected = 0: log message no. 5; next SA.

steps.text: Read the SA header, detail items, sub items and the FIX parameters (sources ielp.SA_HEADER, ielp.SA_DETAIL, ielp.SA_WBS_PERCENTAGE (inferred), ielp.TB_M_SYSTEM (inferred): TBD - Requires ELIPS table/column confirmation) and validate them (Functional Description 4.2).
children: VPLD approval no longer valid: log message no. 15. Invalid: log message no. 6; SA FAILED (step 11); next SA.

steps.text: Duplicate check in PAS (before any PR number is consumed): SELECT PR_NO, PROCESS_ID FROM TB_R_PR_H WHERE PR_DESC = SA_NUMBER.
children: Found: log message no. 7; SA SUCCESS with that PR_NO (step 11); next SA.

steps.text: BEGIN TRANSACTION (PAS). PROCESS_ID = dbo.fn_get_last_process_id(); INSERT TB_R_LOG_H. Run the PAS PR numbering block (parameterised, same logic): TB_M_PROCUREMENT_TYPE -> TB_M_DOC_NUMBERING (UPDATE CURRENT_NUMBER) -> TB_H_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, sp_PutLog.
children: Result 'FAILED' / empty / error: log message no. 8; go to step 10 (rollback).

steps.text: INSERT TB_R_PR_H (WHERE NOT EXISTS PR_DESC; rows affected must be 1), INSERT TB_T_PR_H. Per detail item: INSERT TB_R_PR_ITEM, TB_T_PR_ITEM; per sub item: INSERT TB_R_PR_SUBITEM, TB_T_PR_SUBITEM (Data Map).
children: Error or rows affected <> expected: log message no. 9; rollback.

steps.text: EXEC SP_ILS_GENERATE_PR_ITEM @PROCESS_ID (check RESULT, TBD); EXEC sp_prcreation_budgetProcessing (PROCESS_ID, DIVISION_ID, PR_NO, SA_NUMBER, CREATED_BY, 'NEW_COMMIT', 0, 'SC'); INSERT TB_T_JOB_AUTOPO when eligible (Functional Description 4.5).
children: SP_ILS_GENERATE_PR_ITEM: log message no. 10; budget: log message no. 11; Auto PO: log message no. 12. Rollback.

steps.text: COMMIT (PAS); log message no. 13. On any error in steps 7-9: ROLLBACK (PAS); nothing of this SA stays in PAS (incl. PR number, TB_R_LOG_H).
children: Deadlock / timeout / connection lost: log message no. 17. Rollback itself fails: log message no. 16.

steps.text: Update ielp.SA_DETAIL in ELIPS: SUCCESS (PR_NO, PROCESS_ID, END_DT, ERROR_MESSAGE NULL) or FAILED (ERROR_MESSAGE, END_DT, RETRY_COUNT + 1). Optional write-back of PR_NO to ielp.SA_HEADER (TBD - Requires ELIPS table/column confirmation).
children: Update error after PAS commit: log message no. 14; SA stays PROCESSING and step 2 of the next run reconciles it.

steps.text: End of run: log message no. 19. Unexpected Talend error: log message no. 20.

func_desc.text: DESCRIPTION

Talend moves approved SA (ELIPS TC-PBR) into PAS as a Purchase Requisition, DB-to-DB, replacing the JSON input of the current tJava job. ELIPS owns SA data and approval; Talend only orchestrates; PAS owns PROCESS_ID, PR numbering, PR processing, budget and Auto PO. No PO is created by Talend.
4.1 Interface status (ELIPS)

rows: SA approved and ready to send; set by ELIPS (rule TBD) or reset by user (resend)
PR committed in PAS (or found by PR_DESC); PR_NO stored
Attempt failed, PAS rolled back; retried while RETRY_COUNT < max

func_desc.text: 4.2 Validation before PAS (no PAS row is written for an invalid SA)
Header: SA_NUMBER, TC_VENDOR_CD, CREATED_BY (or FIX CREATED_BY) present.
At least one detail item; ITEM_NO unique in the SA; COST numeric; ORDER_FINISH_DATE parses as yyyy-MM-dd[ HH:mm:ss]; ORDER_NO, ROUTE present.
Sub item: SUB_ITEM unique per item; TARIF numeric; WBS_NO, GL_ACCOUNT, COST_CENTER_CD present. Item without sub item: TBD (OQ-11).
FIX parameters: PR_TYPE, DIVISION_ID (numeric), VALUATION_CLASS, SOURCE_TYPE present; numeric FIX values (PR_QTY, EXCHANGE_RATE, LOCAL_AMOUNT, OPEN_QTY, USED_QTY, SUBITEM_QTY) parse.
4.3 Idempotency
Key SA_NUMBER = TB_R_PR_H.PR_DESC. Checked in step 6 before a PR number is taken, and again by the header insert (WHERE NOT EXISTS, rows affected must be 1).
A SUCCESS SA is never selected again. A PROCESSING SA older than the timeout is reconciled by PR_DESC (step 2).
4.4 Transaction
One PAS transaction per SA (steps 7-10). One SA failing does not affect the others.
ELIPS and PAS are separate databases: no distributed (2PC) transaction. Consistency = claim (PROCESSING) + PAS commit + ELIPS update + reconciliation by PR_DESC.
Stored procedures run inside the Talend transaction; their own BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK handling must be confirmed by PAS (OQ-05).
4.5 Auto PO eligibility (PAS logic, unchanged)

Insert TB_T_JOB_AUTOPO ('PR', PR_NO, NULL, 'ILSTC', GETDATE(), 0, 0) when any item of the PR has VALUATION_CLASS whose TB_M_VALUATION_CLASS.PURCHASING_GROUP_CD is in TB_M_SYSTEM (FUNCTION_ID 'AUTOPO', SYSTEM_CD 'PURCHASING_GROUP_CD', split by ',' with fnSplitString) and SOURCE_TYPE in TB_M_SYSTEM FUNCTION_ID 'SRCILS'.
Proposed guard: AND NOT EXISTS (TB_T_JOB_AUTOPO with same TYPE and DOCUMENT_NO). The PAS Auto PO job creates the PO; Talend does not.
4.6 Kept as-is (observations, not changed silently)

rows: Header DELIVERY_PLAN_DT = run date; item DELIVERY_PLAN_DT = ORDER_FINISH_DATE

func_desc.text: 4.7 Fixes required by the redesign (current tJava defects)

rows: Rollback per SA (today: no rollback; partial data committed by a later SA)
Duplicate check before numbering (today a PR number is consumed for a duplicate SA)
Numbering loop never ends when the number is used (PAS fix, OQ-04)
Check rows affected and SP RESULT

func_desc.text: 4.8 Open questions

rows: ELIPS interface status: a separate ELIPS table (placeholder ielp.SA_DETAIL) or columns on the SA header (the PAS block proposed in the SA Monitoring spec)? Physical names and lengths.
ELIPS source tables / columns for SA header, detail and sub item, and the exact 'approved and ready to send' condition (approval history (TBD)). Who sets READY?
Where are the FIX_PARAMETER values (PR_TYPE, DIVISION_ID, VALUATION_CLASS, SOURCE_TYPE, DEFAULT_VALUES, ...) stored in ELIPS, and by which key (global, per SA type, per trucking company)?

PR numbering loop: when the next number is already used (TB_H_DOCUMENT_NUMBER USED_STATUS 'Y') CURRENT_NUMBER is not advanced, so the WHILE loop never ends. Can PAS fix the block (advance the number, read TB_M_DOC_NUMBERING WITH (UPDLOCK))? Until then Talend only adds a query timeout.

Do SP_ILS_GENERATE_PR_ITEM, sp_prcreation_budgetProcessing and sp_PutLog open / commit / roll back their own transaction or use TRY-CATCH that swallows errors? Can they run inside the Talend transaction? What do they return on error (RESULT values, RAISERROR, return code)?
fn_get_last_process_id(): a function cannot write, so how is a unique PROCESS_ID guaranteed when PAS online users and Talend run at the same time? Is the TB_R_LOG_H insert the reservation?

TB_R_LOG_H: keep MODULE_ID / FUNCTION_ID '1' / '1', END_DT = start and PROCESS_STATUS 1, or update END_DT / PROCESS_STATUS at the end (status codes)? Must PAS log rows survive a rollback (separate connection)?
PR_NOTES (Observation C): keep NULL (as-is) or insert 'ILSTC_yyyyMMdd_1' as the code computes?
SA_DET_NUMBER (Observation D): should it be sent to PAS for traceability (the old commented code put it in MAT_DESC)?
SERVICE_TYPE (Observation E): does PAS need it, and in which column? No target is mapped until confirmed.

Amounts: header LOCAL_AMOUNT comes from FIX (not the sum of item COST); item ORI_AMOUNT = COST (not COST x PR_QTY); sub item amount = TARIF. Is an item without sub item allowed? Must the sum of sub item TARIF equal the item COST?
Observations A / B: header DELIVERY_PLAN_DT and PROC_MONTH use the run date. Correct for an SA of the previous month that is sent after month end?
PR_DESC as idempotency key: is there a unique index? Can a PAS user create a PR with the same description? If the PR is cancelled in PAS, may the SA be sent again?
Run schedule, maximum retry (proposed 3), PROCESSING timeout (proposed 30 min). Who resets FAILED to READY (SA Monitoring Resend)?
PO number back to ELIPS: separate interface (SA Monitoring PO feedback). PAS PO table / column names are not in the supplied information.
Terminology: 'SA' is Service Acceptance in ELIPS TC-PBR; the request also mentions 'Shipping Advice'. Confirm the meaning.
SA type: do both SA by resource (daily orders) and the monthly fixed-cost SA use this interface with the same FIX parameters?
CREATED_BY: FIX CREATED_BY overrides the SA creator (as-is). Which PAS user id must be used (must it exist in PAS for budget processing)?
Are ELIPS and PAS databases on the same SQL Server instance (or is MSDTC / a linked server allowed)? Only then can the ELIPS SUCCESS update be inside the PAS transaction (requirement step 13).
DOC_DT / CREATED_DT use the Talend server clock, other dates use the PAS GETDATE(). Same time zone / clock?
